title: Relaxing massage in a small oasis in the center of Barcelona
text: It was a gift I was given and I enjoyed it very much. The service was very good from the beginning. They ask you about the type of massage you want and choose the fragrance of the oil they will use. The massage therapist was watching me to adjust the strength of the massage and that the experience was as pleasant as possible. At the end of the massage you have the possibility to shower to remove the oil, which is very comfortable. I would totally recommend the experience.
